text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —Mm. All goals cleared.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The training camp leading up to the Kikuka 
Sho seemed to deliver results that Air 
Shakur found thoroughly satisfying.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
After that, I'll feed the overall results 
to "Parcae" in a good environment.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho... It might turn out to be 
even more than we expected.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur has fully learned to talk about 
the future. It's very heartwarming to see, 
but...
choice_data_list:
(I couldn't really serve as a backup, 
huh?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still exhausted from the vigorous advance 
preparations, I had been bustling around 
non-stop during this training camp without 
getting a good night's sleep.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Huh? Yawn as much as you want."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hey, we're switching seats.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...? I could have sworn... Tachyon-san 
was the one sitting next to me..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You want the seat next to that guy?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No, nothing in particular...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Then who gives a damn?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Sit over there. It's quiet next to this 
guy. Sleep if you want to.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...How unexpected. You went out of your 
way to negotiate with Tachyon-san just for 
that?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
How thoughtful of your Trainer... isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You haven't grasped it at all, have you? 
It's about efficiency. Efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You'd better take every chance to sleep 
that you get. I don't need you screwing up 
from lack of rest.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Shakur-san, are you really sure 
you want to be near me?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You're not very good with this, are 
you...? You know, *this* sort of vibe—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'll take a different seat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Air Shakur's consideration, I 
was able to get some good sleep on the way 
back...
